name: agentstack
description: Work Graph control plane for AgentStack. Use the bundled remote MCP connector at https://agentstack.tech/mcp.

interface.longDescription: Link AgentStack first: in Codex open this plugin → MCP Connectors → agentstack → Connect and sign in at agentstack.tech (fallback https://agentstack.tech/mcp/connect). Then call auth.get_profile via agentstack.execute. If unauthorized, guide the user through Connect — do not use auth.login, Device Code, or a second MCP server. Do not silently create an anonymous project.
defaultPrompt: Help me connect AgentStack (Connect on the bundled MCP, then auth.get_profile).
What is the next Work Graph step on this project?
